# Version 4.152.0
> **Graphite GPU backend preview** · [NuGet (prerelease)](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.152.0-preview)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.152.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.152.0 previews the Graphite GPU backend, async pixel readback, and Skia milestone 152. It adds Vulkan/Metal/Dawn Graphite bindings, a backend-neutral async RequestReadPixels API, a new SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET package, Nano Server font support, and several native use-after-free and leak fixes.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Engine

- **Skia updated to milestone 152** — Bundles the Skia m152 engine, rolls up upstream chrome/m151 stability fixes, and refreshes the bundled HarfBuzz to 14.2.1. ([#4651](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4651), [#4568](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4568), [#4538](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4538))

## API Surface

- **Graphite GPU backend bindings** — Adds Graphite GPU backend bindings for Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn, giving access to Skia's next-generation GPU backend. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3968](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3968))
- **Async pixel readback** — Adds a backend-neutral async RequestReadPixels API to SKImage and SKSurface for non-blocking pixel reads. ([#4545](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4545))
- **Vulkan via Silk.NET** — Adds the SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET package and enables Vulkan tests on Android and Linux. ([#4527](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4527))
- **Nano Server font support** — Uses FreeType to enable font rendering on Windows Nano Server containers. — ❤️ [@jeffska](https://github.com/jeffska) ([#4280](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4280))

## Bug Fixes

- **Native use-after-free and leak fixes** — Fixes a native use-after-free in SKRegion.SpanIterator, a use-after-free in SKPixmap.ExtractSubset and With* methods, and a CoTaskMem pixel-buffer leak in SKImage.Create's raster failure path. ([#4355](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4355), [#4558](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4558), [#4455](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4455))

## Platform

- **Containerized and cross-platform test coverage** — Adds containerized test legs for Azure Linux, Alpine/musl, and Nano Server, and initializes the MSVC environment once per native build on Windows. — ❤️ [@mmitche](https://github.com/mmitche) ([#4515](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4515), [#4570](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4570))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1

Refreshes the bundled HarfBuzz to 14.2.1.
